text:
I think you did the right thing working and studying by yourself. I don’t know what work you do but working in gans with kids can greatly improve Hebrew. 

Able to speak is so important, that will help you in the long run. Ulpan in great but if you don’t practice as well as continue to speak in Hebrew after Ulpan it’s a waste of time and money in my opinion, you can always go to Ulpan in the future. 

If possible arrange a speaking course weekly with a tutor. That will help you immensely.
